0022600104.text: The Miami Heat (0-2, 15th in the East and 5th in the Southeast, 2 games back) visit the Charlotte Hornets (1-1, 8th in the East and 3rd in the Southeast, 1 game back) in the third game of the season for Miami, and both of the Heat's losses have come at home. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while Miami won the 2025-26 series 3-1, though the most recent meeting on March 17, 2026, in Charlotte ended with a 136-106 Heat loss. Pelle Larsson is day-to-day with a finger sprain and is a game-time decision for Miami, while Charlotte is without Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel (both out with hamstring injuries) and Kylan Boswell (out after knee surgery), and Coby White is day-to-day with a calf strain and is also a game-time decision.
